checkin: Aloha! Mahalo for booking with Tiki Time Bay Tours! We look forward to sharing with you the most unique experience on San Diego Bay. 🤙 Important Info Absolutely no outside food or beverages permitted. It gets cool and breezy on the bay! We suggest bringing something to keep you warm.
cancellation: Cancellation/Refund Policy Due to the uptick in unfounded credit card disputes, ALL cancelations and reschedule requests MUST be in writing (email or text) no later than 24 hours (not 22 hours, not 23.5 hours 😁) before your scheduled departure time. No phone calls for cancelations/rescheduling will be accepted.
